_comment_about_this_file: Schema example for ~/.webterm-kit/services.json. Copy entries you want into the live file. Re-run install.sh to apply.

_schema.name: shown on the card (string, required)
_schema.category: tab to render under: services | storage | media (default: services)
_schema.icon: emoji or single char shown left of name (string, optional)
_schema.url: where the card links to. Use a /path for proxied services or a https://… URL for external ones (string, required to be useful)
_schema.proxy_to: host:port the local backend listens on. If set together with a /path url, install.sh adds a Caddy reverse_proxy block (string, optional)

services.name: filebrowser
services.description: browse and download files on the Mac

services.name: github
services.description: external link example — no proxy, just opens in a tab
